more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Citric acid is used as a sequestrant in food. Its technological role is to bind metal ions.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children, unripened cheese excluding products falling in category 16, whey cheese, fats and oils essentially free from water  (excluding anhydrous milk fat). These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Can be recovered from citrus or pineapple juice, or produced by fermenting carbohydrate solutions with suitable yeasts or non-toxin-producing Aspergillus niger strains.
